purpose: Start a UI element (box, text, panel, etc.)
Set integer attribute (direction, disabled, checked, selected, tab_index, weight)
Set float attribute (padding, spacing, corner_radius, radius, font_size, opacity, border_width, width, height, min, max, step)
Set string attribute (fill_color, border_color, ink_color, title, variant, role, align, font_family, placeholder, tooltip, distribution, axis)
Read i64 state value (Int, Bool, ptr<T> persistence)
Display frame (flip swapchain or blit GDI surface)
Attach native window handle to session
Read f64 state value (Float persistence; NaN sentinel for not-found)
Read String state value ("" sentinel for not-found)
Bind event callback to element (on_click, on_change, etc.)
